description: This PHP class defines the entity 'ReviewerGroup' used in the OrangeHRM system. It maps to the database table 'ohrm_reviewer_group' and represents groups of reviewers, such as supervisors or employees, within the human resource management context. The class includes properties for id, name, piority, and a collection of associated reviewers, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: ReviewerGroup
classes.description: Entity class representing a reviewer group in the HRM system, with properties for id, name, piority, and relations to reviewers.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the reviewer group.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the reviewer group.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the reviewer group.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the reviewer group.

methods.name: getPiority
methods.description: Returns the piority value of the reviewer group.

methods.name: setPiority
methods.description: Sets the piority value of the reviewer group.
